stem: Why is the clothing store setting important to the plot of the story “Tasha’s Hat”?

options.text: It allows Tasha to consider how much she really wants something.
It shows how the seasons change over the course of a year.
It gives Tasha a chance to compare the price of the hat over time.
It gives Tasha a chance to talk to Sophie about the ways they are different.
It allows new information about fashion to be shared.
